task: figure relevance, identical protocol to the human annotation (48 items x 8 candidate crops)

human_reference.note: too small to be gold; used only to calibrate judges

judges.name: harness gold (model-generated, pre-existing)
judges.note: agreement at chance on 80% of links; the bar to clear

judges.name: Qwen-SEA-LION-v4-8B-VL (on-prem, free)
judges.note: comprehension fine (15/19 of human positives found) but 2.9x too permissive

judges.name: claude-sonnet via subagent, images read directly
judges.note: moderate agreement, 1.4x permissive; the usable instrument

caveats: One human annotator, so no inter-annotator bound exists: we cannot say how much of the residual disagreement is judge error versus annotator idiosyncrasy.

The analyst (Claude) and the best judge (Claude Sonnet) share a vendor. The systems being judged are not Claude, so classic self-preference does not apply, but the judge may align with the analyst's framing of the task more than a neutral judge would.
kappa 0.552 supports detecting large effects. It does not support fine distinctions, and every number derived from this gold must carry it.
